regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative Hong Kong tape: Banks (H + HK) is the only leadership theme with both rank-1 score (1.188) and trend-gate eligibility (true), while energy/challenger is non-eligible. Fourteen of seventeen themes are below the eligibility gate and the whole structure is mean-revert tagged at the leader level with breadth only 0.462 — worth noting that only ONE theme (China Tech & Internet, 3033.HK) carries a scorable proxy, and it is ranked 13th and non-eligible. On this market history the absolute-trend gate does help cut drawdown (gate_helps true), but the only checkable, scorable subject is a bottom-ranked laggard, so honest conviction must be low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Energy (H-shares) — the rank-2 challenger with score 0.98 and hurst_tag trend — turns eligible=true and narrows the 0.208 margin against Banks, which would be the earliest observable sign of a confirmed leadership handoff worth revisiting.
